title: On ultraproduct approximations and property (T) factors
summary: We introduce a framework allowing for key aspects of deformation/rigidity theory to be used in the study of continuous model theory of II$_1$ factors. Using this framework, we solve several well-known open problems in the area. For example, we show that the group von Neumann algebras $L(\operatorname{SL}_3(\mathbb Z))$ and $L \mathbb F_2$ are not elementarily equivalent, and we show that the group von Neumann algebra $L\mathbb F_2$ is not pseudomatricial.
